an6.89:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo diṭṭhisampadaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.89:1.3: sakkāya diṭṭhiṃ, vicikicchaṃ, sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ rāgaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ dosaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ.
an6.89:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo diṭṭhisampadaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.89:2.1: cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo diṭṭhisampadaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.89:2.3: sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ, vicikicchaṃ, sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ, apāyagāmaniyaṃ rāgaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ dosaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ.
an6.89:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo diṭṭhisampadaṃ sacchikātunti.
